Hi Alex / Jordan —

Great talking earlier today. Thanks for the time — I captured the follow-ups and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached. High level:

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for in-product recommendation generation (low-latency, high-throughput).
- Proposed eval window: 3 weeks (POC + perf tests + quality checks).
- Suggested owners: Engineering owner to drive integration, Procurement owner for contract & security intake.

Can you confirm the owners for engineering and procurement and whether the proposed 3-week timeline works?

Next steps I recommend:
1) Jordan to assign engineering owner and confirm any required test data access.
2) Alex/Mia to confirm procurement timeline and any required redlines.
3) We kick off technical onboarding (SE + infra) once owners confirmed — I copied Dev from our side.

Attachment: acme-map-v1.xlsx (Mutual Action Plan - milestones, owners, dates)

If it's helpful I can send a calendar invite for a quick kickoff this week.

Thanks,
